facts.fact: Janu fell asleep at the kitchen fire waiting up with Asha's supper warm on the night she died, woke at the cock, and found the body when she went out for water in the grey. She has kept ten paces from the stair foot for six years for this reason; in ch 23 she crosses them for the first time.
facts.why: needed because the outline has Janu confess her own guilt (asleep at the kitchen fire).

facts.fact: The iron grate under the eleventh step is the outer face of the old slop-gate postern, which opens on the outside path under the wall; the old gate was wood strapped with iron, locked with a fist-sized lock and barred, and is now replaced by new iron with file-bright bolts. Gopan did not make or order it, and Devan gave no order for it.
facts.why: needed to set up Gopan's line that the postern was always locked and only the physician has the key.

facts.fact: Gopan says nobody but the physician (Eravi) has ever carried the postern key: not Gopan, not Bhaskaran, not Janu.
